Do More with an AZ MVD Now Account

Sign up in minutes to get these benefits:

  • Skip the office visit

    Renew your registration and handle routine services online, any time.

  • All documents in one place

    Find letters, records, and confirmations under My Account whenever you need them.

  • Manage plates and titles

    Order specialty plates, transfer a title, and check the status of an order.

  • Pay and track receipts

    Review what you owe, pay online, and pull up past receipts.

Got a Letter from MVD?

Follow these steps to understand your letter and what to do next.

  1. 1

    Sign in to AZ MVD Now

    No account? Sign up (opens in a new tab) first.

  2. 2

    Find your letter

    Go to My Account › My Documents.

  3. 3

    Scan the QR code

    If your letter has one, scan it for answers to common questions.

  4. 4

    Review your compliance issues

    Go to Other › Manage Compliance Issues.

Have a court order? Contact MVD (opens in a new tab) before you act on it.
